changelog: 1.1.0 (Jellyfin 12.2 to 12.4): start of the 1.1 series. From now on a version groups a coherent set of changes (1.minor.patch: features in a minor version, fixes in a patch) instead of one version per change, so updates are fewer and each says more. Same features as 1.0.55 — German and Spanish interface, visual preview, discovery boldness slider, reasons on title pages, three settings levels, honest calibration gains; the full history is in CHANGELOG.md. The catalogue no longer lists 1.0.36, which was never released.
